evidence: sed -n 430,470p scripts/ops/run_training_cycle.sh -> 'except Exception as exc: report = {"ok": True, "quarantine": False, "audit_error": ...}' and '2>/dev/null || echo OK'.

claim: fred_macro and fred_corpus stamp every FRED series at observation date + 1 day, but H.10 series (DTWEXBGS, DEX*) are released weekly, so rows carry dollar/FX values up to ~7 days before publication.
evidence: curl fredgraph.csv?id=DTWEXBGS at 2026-09-27T13:32Z -> last obs '2026-09-18,119.5133', series page updated 'Sep 21, 2026', next 'Sep 28, 2026' (dataset-features lane).

detector: Test: H.10 series stamped at the following Monday.
proposed_fix: release_lag_days map or ALFRED realtime_start.

claim: compute_macro_feature_rows writes 0.0 for a series absent on a given date, so on a bond-market holiday ust10y_level drops from 4.1 to 0.0 and overwrites the carried-forward real value.

claim: The IBKR historical stitch iterates contracts newest-expiry-first and keeps the first bar per ts, so wherever a deferred contract has bars it replaces the front month.

claim: setup_candidates locates a backtest trade's feature bar by raw string bisect, and harness timestamps are str(pd.Timestamp) with a space separator while bars use 'T', so every backtest row takes features from the previous day's last bar (hour_of_day 23).

proposed_fix: Parse to UTC datetimes before bisecting; normalise in record_harness_trades; re-run M23 EV-gate evidence.

claim: setup_candidates places a live trade on the bar whose open is at or before entry (the bar forming at entry), so that bar's close — up to one bar after entry — enters log_return / vols / momentum of the real-money eval rows.

proposed_fix: Locate bar_open + tf <= entry_ts on parsed datetimes.

claim: exit_candidates._load_live_trades_for_exit filters only is_backtest=0 AND is_demo=0, so a portfolio-mirror paper trade (account_class='paper') with synthesized pnl is emitted as is_live_trade=True on the real-money holdout.
